verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a project-management SaaS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of Basecamp. The pack covers only the hosted product, its API, CLI and MCP support, and one community comment frames Basecamp as the hosted tool that self-hosted alternatives compete against.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
